# Qazi Forex Tips

> Free forex and Gold (XAUUSD) trading education in Urdu and Hindi for traders in Pakistan and India, led by Dr. Qazi Abdul Basit (trading since 2013, 65+ student batches, 14.5K+ YouTube subscribers). Free courses, guides and free MT5 tools. We do not sell signals, do not manage accounts and earn nothing from any broker.

## Free MT5 tools
- [Free MT5 Indicators & Forex Tools](https://qaziforextips.com/free-mt5-tools.html): all free tools in one place.
- [QFT Sessions & Killzones – free ICT killzones indicator for MT5 and MT4](https://qaziforextips.com/ict-killzones-indicator-mt5.html): Asia, London and New York sessions in Pakistan (PKT) and India (IST) time, all four ICT killzones, automatic daylight saving, previous day high/low, and liquidity sweep → MSS setups marked with win rate and total R. 100% free download, no DLL.
- [QFT FVG Pro – free FVG (fair value gap) indicator for MT5 and MT4](https://qaziforextips.com/fvg-indicator-mt5.html): fair value gaps with the 50% CE line, dynamic fill, inversion FVG (IFVG), balanced price range (BPR), higher timeframe FVGs, trend and killzone tags, and a unique self-test that compares FVGs with random zones of the same shape. Our test of 23,773 FVGs on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025, M5/M15): a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 tests (31% vs 28% win rate at 1:2), while "touch and bounce" was no better than random. 100% free download, no DLL.
- [Lot Size Calculator for Forex & Gold](https://qaziforextips.com/lot-size-calculator.html): free online lot size calculator.
- [QFT Replay Simulator](https://qaziforextips.com/simulator.html): market replay and manual backtesting inside MT5 and MT4 (free demo), a Soft4FX / FX Replay alternative.
- [QFT Trade Assistant](https://qaziforextips.com/trade-assistant.html): risk-based lot size and trade panel for MT5 and MT4 (free demo).
